The IAV69A relay is a time delay under 
voltage and over voltage relay designed to be used whenever protection against 
an abnormal voltage condition is required. This relay has two targets and 
closes its left hand contacts when the voltage increases the predetermined value 
and its right contacts when the voltage decreases another predetermined value, 
in both cases one target of the two appears.

items:
Return relay to service by removing the 
 test leads from the relay terminal block and the test set i.e.
 - Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( 15 - 16 )
 - Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( 5 - 6 )
 - Disconnect the test leads from the trip contact

Check that the CT and PT secondary connections return to its normal position as

If any equipment associated with the

Protection | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedure P1, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
The IAV69A relay is a time delay under 
voltage and over voltage relay designed to be used whenever protection against 
an abnormal voltage condition is required. This relay has two targets and 
closes its left hand contacts when the voltage increases the predetermined value 
and its right contacts when the voltage decreases another predetermined value, 
in both cases one target of the two appears.
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Fayza El-Sharkawy, tested by eng. Shirin 
Hamdy & eng. Azza Salama at 29 April 2003, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel El-Nagar, accepted by General Director 
eng. Mahmoud Saker, and approved by eng. Moustfa 
Alam Head Sector of Talkha Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ..etc.
The 
 generator must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Make Sure PT secondary circuit are opened at the incoming terminal 
 blocks before isolating the relay voltage circuit for test.
Look at field maintenance fill and compare the position of the setting 
switches on relay with those shown on the setting sheet.
Make Sure PT secondary circuit are opened at the incoming terminal 
 blocks before isolating the relay voltage circuit for test.
Look at field maintenance fill and compare the position of the setting 
switches on relay with those shown on the setting sheet.
Testing the Relay
Connect test leads between the relay contact ( relay trip ) (1 
 11 ).
Connect test leads between the relay contact ( relay trip ) (1 
 11 ).
Under Voltage Test
Connect test leads between the low voltage terminal ( 5 6 ).
Adjust the voltage to 120V on the secondary injection test set.
Decrease the voltage slowly until the right contact closes and the right flag 
appears.
Record the voltage value and the time value at which the contact closes in the 
test sheet.
Connect test leads between the low voltage terminal ( 5 6 ).
Adjust the voltage to 120V on the secondary injection test set.
Decrease the voltage slowly until the right contact closes and the right flag 
appears.
Over Voltage Test
Connect the test leads between the high voltage terminals ( 15 
16 ) .
Adjust the voltage to 120V on the secondary injection test set.
Increase the voltage slowly until the left contact closes and the left flag 
appears and trips.
Record the voltage and the time values in the test sheet.
Connect the test leads between the high voltage terminals ( 15 
16 ) .
Adjust the voltage to 120V on the secondary injection test set.
Increase the voltage slowly until the left contact closes and the left flag 
appears and trips.
Record the voltage and the time values in the test sheet.
Return Relay and associated Equipment to 
Service
Return relay to service by removing the 
 test leads from the relay terminal block and the test set i.e.
 - Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( 15 - 16 )
 - Disconnect the test leads from the terminals ( 5 - 6 )
 - Disconnect the test leads from the trip contact 
 ( 1 - 11 )
Check that the CT and PT secondary connections return to its normal position as 
before the test.
If any equipment associated with the 
 relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service by the following 
 restoration steps:
 - Breaker trip coils.
 - Breaker failure scheme associated this relay.
 - Disturbance alarm and fault recorder associated with this relay.

sections_ar.text: تسرد هذه الوثيقة إجراءات الاختبار P1، التي يجب تنفيذها على أساس سنوي كما هو موضح بـ Y1 في خانة العنوان أعلاه

ريلاي IAV69A هو ريلاي انخفاض جهد وزيادة جهد ذو تأخير زمني، مصمم للاستخدام كلما لزمت الوقاية ضد حالة جهد غير طبيعية. ولهذا الريلاي هدفان، ويغلق تلامساته اليسرى عندما يزيد الجهد عن القيمة المحددة مسبقًا، وتلامساته اليمنى عندما ينخفض الجهد عن قيمة محددة مسبقًا أخرى، وفي كلتا الحالتين يظهر أحد الهدفين

أعدّ المسودة الأولى م. Fayza El-Sharkawy، واختبرتها م. Shirin Hamdy وم. Azza Salama في 29 أبريل 2003، وراجعها مهندس مراقبة الجودة م. Adel El-Nagar بشركة EDEPC، وقبلها المدير العام م. Mahmoud Saker، واعتمدها م. Moustfa Alam رئيس قطاع محطة Talkha

sections_ar.text: إعادة جهاز الوقاية والمعدات المرتبطة به إلى الخدمة

items: أعد الريلاي إلى الخدمة بإزالة أسلاك الاختبار من روزتة أطراف الريلاي ومن جهاز الاختبار، أي: - افصل أسلاك الاختبار عن الطرفين (15 - 16) - افصل أسلاك الاختبار عن الطرفين (5 - 6) - افصل أسلاك الاختبار عن تلامس الفصل (1 - 11)
تأكد من عودة توصيلات ثانوي محول التيار ومحول الجهد إلى وضعها الطبيعي كما كانت قبل الاختبار.

إذا تم عزل أي معدة مرتبطة بالريلاي، فيجب إعادتها إلى الخدمة باتباع خطوات الإعادة التالية: - ملفات فصل القاطع. - منظومة فشل القاطع المرتبطة بهذا الريلاي. - إنذار الاضطراب ومسجل الأعطال المرتبطان بهذا الريلاي.
